turnaround_reason: SRPT cratered from the $140s to ~$18 (down ~87% off highs) after safety events (acute liver injury / patient deaths) tied to its Elevidys DMD gene therapy forced a label update and crushed volumes; TTM revenue is down 34% with negative gross margins. The bull case is a still-commercial rare-disease franchise trading near tangible value, a credible new CEO, and heavy insider accumulation.
bullish_points: Very heavy insider buying/alignment: net +907k shares over 6m, including a 756k-share CEO award — management is loading up near the lows
Credible leadership reset: Michael Severino, M.D. (ex-Amgen vice chair) took over as CEO effective July 28, 2026

Efficacy signal intact: 3-year EMBARK data (Jan 2026) showed treated patients holding motor function above baseline vs. declining controls — the drug works, the problem is safety management, not efficacy
Multiple shots on goal: Japan launch (Roche milestone), ENDEAVOR Cohort 8 testing prophylactic sirolimus to reduce ALI risk, and a broader RNA/gene-therapy pipeline
Trades near enterprise value ~$2.3B on ~$2B revenue — a lot of bad news is priced in
bearish_points: Safety overhang is existential, not cosmetic: patient deaths from acute liver injury drove the collapse and any further event could gut the franchise
Financially deteriorating: revenue -34% YoY, negative gross margins (-17%), negative net margin — the P&L is going the wrong way
The key de-risking catalyst (Cohort 8 enhanced immunosuppression data) has no firm public readout date, so the safety cloud persists indefinitely in the meantime
Binary, headline-driven name — a single FDA action or trial death can move it 30%+ overnight in either direction
catalyst: ENDEAVOR Cohort 8 data showing prophylactic sirolimus meaningfully reduces acute liver injury, which would reopen the non-ambulant market and lift the safety overhang
catalyst_timing: Cohort 8 enrollment underway (announced March 2026); data readout timing not firmly disclosed — likely 2027
suggested_trade: Very small speculative starter only, sized as a binary. If expressing via options, defined-risk long calls (Jan 2027) are preferable to spot given the headline gap risk in both directions.
key_risk: Another Elevidys-related death or a punitive FDA label/withdrawal action, which would impair the core revenue base and the equity
would_skip_if: You cannot stomach single-headline 30%+ drawdowns, or a fresh safety signal emerges before Cohort 8 data
